description:
[Deterministic building & transport carbon tax projection. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates the financial impact of the EU ETS 2 carbon pricing system starting 2027 under Directive (EU) 2023/959 for natural gas, heating oil, and LPG across base ceiling (€45), market (€65), and stress (€90) EUA-2 price scenarios.
Usage: Use this tool to forecast carbon tax surcharges on fossil fuels and evaluate heat pump ROI.
Returns: JSON object with { totalAnnualEmissionsTco2e: number, unitCarbonTaxSurchargeEur: object, totalAnnualCarbonTaxCostEur: object, tenYearCumulativeCarbonCostEur: object, decarbonizationEconomics: object }.

annualConsumptionUnits.description: Annual consumption in Smc or Liters

customEuaCarbonPriceEurPerTon.description: Optional custom EUA-2 allowance price in EUR/tCO2e

name: ets2_carbon_tax_projector
